verdict.rationale: Caveman ships an open-source skill and CLI, so a buyer could fairly ask whether installed skills can be listed and cleanly removed. The pack documents no list command, no uninstall or remove command, and no cleanup of leftover files or instructions. The plugins mention (caveman-docs-12) is about plugin compatibility, not managing or removing installed skills.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list what is installed and remove skills cleanly, without orphaned files or lingering instructions
